items.title: burrito-server 缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 知晓仓库URL者可直连服务端点伪造事件，创建或删除TerraformPullRequest资源，破坏GitOps流程
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本并限制服务端点访问
items.repro_note: 向burrito-server端点提交伪造事件，需已知仓库URL
items.description: Anyone who can reach `burrito-server`'s endpoint and knows a tracked repository's URL can forge events to create or delete `TerraformPullRequest` custom resources with attacker-chosen `Branch`, `Base`, and `ID` fields. Auto-apply is disabled for these temporary layers, so this vulnerability alone cannot force a `terraform apply`; plan-time provider and data-source code execution depends on the selected branch's contents.

items.title: Rust zip库解压路径不一致
items.title_zh: Rust zip库解压路径不一致
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造恶意压缩包，使中央目录与流式解压路径不一致，覆盖下游服务文件
items.action_zh: 升级zip库至修复版本，解压后校验输出路径
items.repro_note: 构造中央目录与本地头不一致的压缩包，验证覆盖路径
items.impact_scope: 被广泛依赖的压缩解析库
items.description: zip is a zip library for Rust that supports reading and writing simple ZIP files. A crafted archive can therefore appear benign to a component that inspects the central directory but cause a streaming extractor to write a different attacker-selected path and content, potentially overwriting files used by a downstream service.

items.title: consul-k8s 跨命名空间授权绕过
items.title_zh: consul-k8s 跨命名空间授权绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者借组件ACL绑定规则缺陷跨命名空间越权，获取更高Consul权限
items.action_zh: 升级到2.1.0或1.8.18，审查ACL绑定规则
items.repro_note: 需集群内身份与组件ACL绑定配置，实现跨命名空间提权
items.impact_scope: K8s服务网格控制面，横向提权
items.description: Consul-k8s versions 0.42.0 and later are vulnerable to a cross-namespace authorization bypass in component ACL binding rules that may allow an attacker to obtain elevated Consul privileges. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-110720) is fixed in consul-k8s 2.1.0 and 1.8.18.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG云升级命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者通过云升级接口FileName参数注入系统命令，可完全控制路由器
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息，停用云升级并限制管理面访问
items.impact_scope: 家用/小型企业路由器，边界设备
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. This affects the function setCloudUpgradeFW of the file lib/cste_modules/upgrade.so of the component Cloud Upgrade. The manipulation of the argument FileName leads to command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG防火墙命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者操纵防火墙模块apmib_set参数注入命令，取得路由器控制权
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息，限制管理面访问并监控异常命令
items.repro_note: firewall.so中apmib_set参数未过滤，远程注入命令
items.impact_scope: 家用/小型企业路由器，边界设备
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected is the function apmib_set of the file firewall.so. This manipulation causes command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.title: ArcGIS Server SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 具服务访问权限者（或匿名公开配置）可注入SQL调用数据库函数，读取或篡改数据
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本，将服务访问权限改为非公开
items.repro_note: 需具备服务访问权限，向受影响功能注入SQL语句
items.impact_scope: GIS服务端，常暴露内网/公网
items.description: There is a SQL injection vulnerability in Esri ArcGIS Server versions 12.1 and earlier on Windows and Linux that may allow a remote attacker with privileges to access the service (which could, depending on the service being configured in a non-default access configuration “public”, include an anonymous attacker) to issue database specific functions that should not be allowed.
